SCI-MAP v0.2 — BOUNDED FINAL CORRECTION AND ACCEPTANCE PREFLIGHT

The r0.3 scientific architecture is accepted as the basis for the final
correction/rebuild.

The previous requested repairs are closed:

- candidate profile semantics are distinct from approval, registration,
  source binding, activation, and object-decision realization;
- empty scientific support has the owner-selected not_produced outcome;
- MAP product realization is distinct from application-attempt failure;
- response-bearing coadds bind an exact response family and fixed composition
  state;
- shared science, formal render, rationale, and ECS have distinct authority
  roles;
- numerical full-procedure differences use the named comparison-space record.

Do not reopen the estimator, projection, coefficient family, exposure model,
coverage_cut policy, six product roles, response taxonomy, coadd arithmetic,
NOI claim ceilings, or downstream ownership.

Preserve SCI-MAP-REQ-001--052 and SCI-MAP-PRED-001--025.

Perform the following bounded corrections.

1. REPAIR PRED-025: ZERO IS QUANTITY-SPECIFIC

The current statement that an “exact-zero ... aggregate/index never becomes
a live valid product” is overbroad and contradicts the admitted estimator and
zero-based indexing.

Amend PRED-025 in the shared authority and regenerate its ECS rendering.

Require:

- a zero signal numerator with finite positive normalization and valid support
  remains admissible;
- a zero normalized scientific signal is not, by itself, invalid;
- an in-bounds zero-based index is valid;
- a zero centered-integer placement offset is valid when the grids satisfy the
  exact embedding rule;
- zero normalization never authorizes division or a supported scientific row;
- zero coefficients retain their existing noncontributing treatment;
- coverage_cut=0 and the N=0, Q_star=0 boundary convention retain their existing
  meanings;
- non-finite, overflowed, out-of-domain, and unrepresentable quantities follow
  their exact declared failure scopes;
- an empty support-authorized output-row set retains the approved not_produced
  outcome and no-support cause.

Do not confuse a scientifically valid measured value of zero with a fabricated
zero substituted for unavailable support.

Add fixtures under the existing predictions/evidence mappings for:

A. Two otherwise admitted samples +a and -a in one pixel with equal positive
   coefficients, giving N=0, Q>0, and a valid normalized value zero.

B. An admitted constant-zero input on nonempty valid support.

C. Memory index zero and zero placement offset under valid domain conditions.

D. Zero normalization and a valid applied policy with empty output support,
   retaining their distinct row/product outcomes.

No new estimator or owner-selected numerical parameter is introduced.

2. REPLACE EXPANDED PARAGRAPHS WITH SHORT NORMATIVE REFERENCES

The complete empty-support disposition is repeatedly inserted into sentences
that expect a short reference. Examples include:

    “That prospective case uses The 2026-09-08 owner directive selects ...”

    “that applied attempt follows The 2026-09-08 owner directive selects ...”

    “... alternative is authorized. and is not an admitted coadd member.”

Keep the complete empty-support rule once in the shared authority under an
exact section/label.

Replace repeated paragraph insertions with grammatical short references.
Retain each requirement’s direct obligation and traceability.

Audit REQ-009, REQ-012, REQ-031, REQ-032, REQ-033, REQ-039, and REQ-048,
plus their ECS renderings.

Do not change the approved empty-support outcome.

Replace “like-named cause” everywhere with the exact cause token:

    no_support_authorized_output_rows.

Distinguish a short reference macro from a full rule-body macro if that is the
source of the rendering defect.

3. CLARIFY VAL EVALUATION ORDER IN THE ECS

Repair execution step 3.

When producing a new decision:

- verify exact profile semantics, owner approval, Registry/source binding,
  activation/evaluability, and required object facts;
- perform the evaluation;
- verify the resulting decision-artifact identity, four-axis state, causes,
  and realization;
- only then consume the decision for MAP admission.

When consuming an existing decision, verify its exact binding and realization
before MAP admission.

Do not require the decision artifact as a prerequisite for creating itself.
Do not introduce a new VAL disposition function.

4. REMOVE AVOIDABLE REPETITION AND PAGE SPILLS

Do not reduce font sizes, line spacing, or margins.

- Eliminate the ECS contents page carrying only the final contents entry.
- Avoid the mostly empty continuation page in the ECS result-vocabulary
  section where normal flow can resolve it.
- Consolidate the rationale’s final authority paragraph with an existing
  authority/status section.
- Render the complete lifecycle once per view; use precise references rather
  than repeating its complete explanation.
- Keep candidate-status facts clearly visible without inserting the full
  status paragraph into every scientific clause.

This is editorial cleanup, not a new document-architecture task.
No page-count target is an acceptance condition.

5. REBUILD AND VERIFY THE EXACT SUCCESSOR BYTES

Keep contract version v0.2; advance the document/source revision under the
existing versioning convention.

Return:

- corrected formal contract, rationale, and ECS;
- exact shared-authority source and source inventory;
- corrected PRED-025 and fixture mapping;
- the small semantic-change report;
- requirement/prediction identity and view-parity report;
- source, owner-directive, boundary, profile, and build bindings;
- clean-build and all-page rendering checks;
- final manifest and matching delivery sidecar.

Separate:

- the PRED-025 semantic clarification;
- ECS sequencing clarification;
- cross-reference/prose repair;
- deduplication and pagination.

Verify that all 52 requirements and 25 predictions remain uniquely identified
and that the corrected zero cases cannot be classified by a generic
“zero means invalid” rule.

6. DISPOSITION

Return the corrected bytes for explicit conditional scientific-owner
acceptance/freeze.

Do not open another broad scientific revision unless the bounded checks
demonstrate an actual contradiction.

Conditional scientific acceptance does not activate candidate profiles,
realize a PTC coefficient handoff, supply an unavailable parent, authorize a
numerical MAP route, establish implementation conformity or response/covariance
fidelity, validate observations, establish significance, or authorize
production.
